timeline.text: I post one time for two cities. New York and Oslo don't wake up together.
Ten AM UTC meant six AM in New York, noon in Oslo — someone always got the worst hour.
Now a scheduler checks each city's own ten AM, like a mail carrier who knows every house's hours.
An hourly job checks Supabase, then fires the post the instant it's ten AM, locally, anywhere.
Posting at the right local hour lifted first-hour clicks and shares by up to thirty percent.
